# ----- GLUCOSE ANALYSIS: Diet-controlled vs non-diet-controlled days -----
# This script reads in cleaned %>% CGM data (averages), combines each glucose day to
# its study condition and diet-control status, then 
# compares glucose overall and per condition

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# all of the packages I have been using just in case
library(haven)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(gt)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(gtsummary)
library(broom)
```

```{r, read in data}
# cgm data
cgm <- read_sas(here("DataProcessed", "analysis_v20260609_REVISED"))

# condition dates
cond_long <- read.csv(here("DataProcessed", "cond_dates_long"))

# diet dates
diet_long <- read.csv(here("DataProcessed", "diet_dates_long"))
```

```{r, standardize formatting}
# match the dashed format used in cond_long and diet_long.
cgm <- cgm %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    id = sub("(TAN)(\\d+)", "\\1-\\2", id)
  )

# read.csv reads dates as character
# convert to Date
cond_long <- cond_long %>%
  mutate(
    cond_start = as.Date(cond_start, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
    cond_end = as.Date(cond_end, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
  )

diet_long <- diet_long %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

# join cgm and cond_dates 
cgm <- cgm %>%
  left_join(
    cond_long %>% select(id, condition, cond_num, cond_start, cond_end),
    by = join_by(id, between(date, cond_start, cond_end))
  )

```

```{r, build out diet-controlled vs non-diet controlled}
# Attach the diet-day flag by matching on id + condition + exact date
# CV (coefficient of variation = SD/mean*100) is computed 

glucose_b <- cgm %>%
  left_join(
    diet_long %>% select(id, condition, date, diet_day_flag),
    by = c("id", "condition", "date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_day_flag = replace_na(diet_day_flag, 0),
    diet_label = if_else(diet_day_flag == 1, "Diet-controlled", "Non-diet"),
    cv_24h = sd_glucose / avg_glucose * 100,
    cv_day  = day_sd_glucose / day_glucose * 100,
    cv_night = night_sd_glucose / night_glucose * 100
  )
# check- Baseline should show no diet-controlled days since BL wasn't diet-controlled.
glucose_b %>% count(condition, diet_label)

#remove NAs

glucose_b <- glucose_b  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(condition))

```

```{r, day-level descriptives}
# treats each day as independent, but ignores that days are attached to participants
# just to see descriptives (unpaired)

# diet vs non-diet across all conditions combined.
days_compare <- glucose_b %>%
  group_by(diet_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_days  = n(),
    mean_24h = mean(avg_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_24h = mean(sd_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_24h = mean(cv_24h, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_day = mean(day_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_night  = mean(night_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
days_compare

# diet vs non-diet days, one row per condition x diet status.

cond_compare <- glucose_b %>%
  group_by(condition, diet_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_days  = n(),
    mean_24h  = mean(avg_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_24h  = mean(sd_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_24h  = mean(cv_24h, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_day  = mean(day_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_night  = mean(night_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(condition, diet_label)

cond_compare

# plot 
ggplot(glucose_b%>% filter(!is.na(condition)),
       aes(x = condition, y = avg_glucose, fill = diet_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(0.8), alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "24h mean glucose (mg/dL)", fill = NULL,
       title = "Glucose on diet-controlled vs non-diet days, by condition") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")


```
```{r, participant-paired comparison}
# accounts for repeated measures
# one day per participant per, plus diet mean and non diet mean per condition
paired <- glucose_b %>%
  filter(!is.na(condition)) %>%
  group_by(id, condition, diet_label) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_24h = mean(avg_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_day  = mean(day_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_night = mean(night_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_24h = mean(cv_24h, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

paired_by_cond <- paired %>%
  select(id, condition, diet_label, mean_24h) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet_label, values_from = mean_24h) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Diet-controlled`) & !is.na(`Non-diet`))

paired_by_cond %>% count(condition)

# reshaping data layout - diet and non diet side-by-side
# computes difference within each participant
paired_by_cond <- paired %>%
  select(id, condition, diet_label, mean_24h) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet_label, values_from = mean_24h) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Diet-controlled`) & !is.na(`Non-diet`))

# paired n per condition
paired_by_cond %>% count(condition)

# plot: lines connect same participant between diet and non-diet controlled
# slopes represent difference in glucose
ggplot(paired %>% filter(!is.na(condition)),
       aes(x = diet_label, y = mean_24h, group = id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = diet_label), size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "24h mean glucose (mg/dL)",
       title = "Participant-Paired Glucose: diet-controlled vs non-diet days") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))


```



```{r, paired t-test}
# one diet and one non diet mean per participant averaged across all conditions
paired_overall <- glucose_b %>%
  filter(!is.na(condition)) %>%
  group_by(id, diet_label) %>%
  summarise(mean_24h = mean(avg_glucose, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet_label, values_from = mean_24h) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Diet-controlled`) & !is.na(`Non-diet`))

nrow(paired_overall)

t.test(paired_overall$`Diet-controlled`,
       paired_overall$`Non-diet`,
       paired = TRUE)

# Checking with a single-condition (Fasted-AM), first

fam <- paired_by_cond %>% filter(condition == "Fasted-AM")
nrow(fam)

t.test(fam$`Diet-controlled`, fam$`Non-diet`, paired = TRUE)


#check distributions
# distribution of within-person differences per condition

```
```{r}
condition_tests <- paired_by_cond %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  
  # group_modify applies the test per condition group
  group_modify(~ {
    test <- t.test(.x$`Diet-controlled`, .x$`Non-diet`, paired = TRUE)
    tibble(
      n_pairs = nrow(.x),
      # mean_diff and its 95% CI (not just the p-value
      mean_diff = mean(.x$`Diet-controlled` - .x$`Non-diet`),
      ci_low  = test$conf.int[1],
      ci_high = test$conf.int[2],
      p_value = test$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

condition_tests

# adjust for inflated false-positive by testing conditions separately - correct with Holm
condition_tests <- condition_tests %>%
  mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm"))

condition_tests
```

```{r}
# distribution of within-person differences per condition
paired_by_cond %>%
  mutate(diff = `Diet-controlled` - `Non-diet`) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diff)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Diet-controlled minus non-diet (mg/dL)",
       title = "Within-participant glucose distribution by condition") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# compare with wilcox signed rank test ^ before adjusted
# rank is not the same as mean difference; does person end up in similar place under both conditions
fam <- paired_by_cond %>% filter(condition == "Fed-AM")

t.test(fam$`Diet-controlled`, fam$`Non-diet`, paired = TRUE)
wilcox.test(fam$`Diet-controlled`, fam$`Non-diet`, paired = TRUE)

fedam <- paired_by_cond %>% filter(condition == "Fed-AM")
t.test(fedam$`Diet-controlled`, fedam$`Non-diet`, paired = TRUE)
wilcox.test(fedam$`Diet-controlled`, fedam$`Non-diet`, paired = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# person-level means: one value per participant per condition per diet status
paired <- glucose_b %>%
  filter(!is.na(condition)) %>%
  group_by(id, condition, diet_label) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_24h = mean(avg_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),   # level
    sd_24h = mean(sd_glucose, na.rm = TRUE),    # variability
    cv_24h = mean(cv_24h, na.rm = TRUE),        # variability, normalized
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# helper: paired t-test per condition for a given metric
test_metric <- function(data, metric) {
  data %>%
    select(id, condition, diet_label, value = all_of(metric)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = diet_label, values_from = value) %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Diet-controlled`) & !is.na(`Non-diet`)) %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    filter(n() >= 2) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      t <- t.test(.x$`Diet-controlled`, .x$`Non-diet`, paired = TRUE)
      tibble(
        metric    = metric,
        n_pairs   = nrow(.x),
        mean_diff = mean(.x$`Diet-controlled` - .x$`Non-diet`),
        ci_low    = t$conf.int[1],
        ci_high   = t$conf.int[2],
        p_value   = t$p.value
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# run for all three metrics and stack
results <- bind_rows(
  test_metric(paired, "mean_24h"),
  test_metric(paired, "sd_24h"),
  test_metric(paired, "cv_24h")
) %>%
  arrange(metric, condition)

as.data.frame(results)



```
```{r}
# faceted view: each metric x condition, diet vs non-diet
paired %>%
  pivot_longer(c(mean_24h, sd_24h, cv_24h),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diet_label, y = value, group = id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = diet_label), size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ condition, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Diet vs non-diet days: level and variability by condition") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

Mixed Model
```{r}
library(lme4)

# day-level data, keeping every observation (no averaging)
dat_frame <- cgm_analysis %>%
  filter(!is.na(condition), !is.na(avg_glucose)) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_label = factor(if_else(diet_day_flag == 1, "Diet", "Non-diet")),
    condition  = factor(condition))

# Random intercept by person only:
model <- lme4::lmer(avg_glucose ~ diet_label + (1 | id), data = dat_frame)

# Look at model results:
confint(model )[4,] |> round(2)
summary(model )

# Random intercept by person and by condition:
## (assumes observations from the same participant and from the same condition are more similar than observations from different participants or conditions)
model2 <- lme4::lmer(avg_glucose ~ diet_label + (1 | id) + (1 | condition), data = dat_frame)

# Look at model results:
confint(model2 )[4,] |> round(2)
summary(model2 )

# Random intercept by person and by condition, and adding an interaction:
model3 <- lme4::lmer(avg_glucose ~ diet_label + condition + diet_label:condition + (1 | id) + (1 | condition), 
                     data = dat_frame)
# Look at model results:
confint(model3 )[4,] |> round(2)
summary(model3 )

# model 3 is not converging as well as the first two- try having condition as a fixed effect only and not also a random effects intercept for each condition


```

```{r}
# model 3 is not converging as well as the first two- try having condition as a fixed effect only and not also a random effects intercept for each condition
# diet and condition both fixed, plus their interaction; random intercept for person only

#model3 <- lme4::lmer(avg_glucose ~ diet_label * condition + (1 | id), data = dat_frame)

# check the coefficient rows before indexing (interaction adds rows)
#rownames(confint(model3))

# fed- pm is being dropped- likely because baseline condition
# diet vs non-diet only makes sense within exercise conditions (BL has no diet days)
model_dat_ex <- dat_frame %>%
  filter(condition != "BL") %>%
  mutate(condition = droplevels(condition))   # drop the empty BL level

model3 <- lme4::lmer(avg_glucose ~ diet_label * condition + (1 | id),
                     data = model_dat_ex)

summary(model3)
rownames(confint(model3))

# how many observations in each diet x condition cell?
model_dat_ex %>% count(condition, diet_label) %>% tidyr::pivot_wider(
  names_from = diet_label, values_from = n)
```
```{r}
# comparing model fits\

# Fixed-effects comparison: model nests within model3 because adds condition + interaction as fixed effects
# Question: does model 3's complexity significantly improve the fit over model 1?
anova(model, model3)
```
